settings.heading: Healthy soil. Stronger
settings.text: A science-backed, eco-friendly soil conditioner designed to improve fertility, water retention, root development and nutrient absorption.

settings.title: Improves soil health
settings.text: Supports soil fertility and creates a better environment for crops.

settings.title: Better water retention
settings.text: Helps soil hold moisture for more efficient crop growth.

settings.title: Stronger roots
settings.text: Encourages healthy root development from the foundation up.

settings.title: Nutrient absorption
settings.text: Fulvic acid supports more efficient nutrient uptake by plants.

settings.title: Humic + Fulvic Soil Conditioner
settings.description: Enriched with 70% Potassium Humate and 25% Fulvic Acid to improve soil fertility, water retention, root development and nutrient absorption.

settings.title: Dissolve
settings.text: Open one capsule and add it to 1 glass (200–250 ml) of clean water.

settings.title: Activate
settings.text: Stir well and let it stand for 1–2 hours for best results.

settings.title: Apply
settings.text: Pour the prepared solution into a 15 L sprayer tank, fill with water and spray evenly on crops.

settings.quote: The easy application makes it simple to add soil care to our regular crop routine.
